cancellation_slabs.description: 25% deduction of ticket fare (subject to minimum clerkage charge per passenger).

cancellation_slabs.description: 50% deduction of ticket fare (subject to minimum clerkage charge per passenger).

cancellation_slabs.time_window: Less than 2 hours before boarding time
